title: Edel Finance-linked wallets reportedly ‘snipe’ 30% of token supply: Bubblemaps
summary: Bubblemaps shared blockchain data indicating that team-related wallets had purchased 30% of the token supply, but Edel’s co-founder said the acquisition was part of its token rollout plans.

title: Naver to acquire Upbit operator Dunamu in $10.3B all-stock deal
summary: Naver Financial plans to acquire Dunamu in a $10.3 billion stock-swap deal, issuing 87.56 million new shares and making the crypto giant a wholly owned subsidiary.

title: BIS taps IMF digital money chief and CBDC backer as new head of Innovation Hub
summary: The Bank for International Settlements is advancing major digital currency pilots, testing cross-border CBDCs, tokenized deposits and real-time payment rails.

title: Bitcoin eyes rebound to $96K from current ‘discount’ zone: Analysis
summary: A Bitcoin bull flag on the price charts projected a rebound to $96,000 as the Puell Multiple indicator suggested that BTC is undervalued at current prices.

title: Spain’s junior ruling party proposes 47% crypto tax in ‘attack against Bitcoin’
summary: Spain’s Sumar party reportedly wants to raise crypto taxes to 47%, classify all digital assets as seizable and introduce a “risk traffic light” system.

title: Deutsche Börse locks in third euro stablecoin amid broader EU adoption
summary: Deutsche Börse is integrating AllUnity’s EURAU stablecoin into its market infrastructure — its third euro-pegged stablecoin — signaling a full-spectrum push.

title: Bitcoin price bottom due ‘this week’ with BTC down 20% in November
summary: Bitcoin losses remained near 20% for November, risking its worst 11th month since the 2018 bear market, but AI predicted a bottom coming this week.

title: Prediction markets are Robinhood’s fastest-growing money maker
summary: Since Robinhood launched its prediction markets in March, nine billion contracts have been traded by more than one million users, according to the platform.

title: Crypto-friendly Trump adviser Hassett top pick for Fed chair: Report
summary: Kevin Hassett, who was central to the president’s crypto working group, has sprung up as a frontrunner to take over the Federal Reserve, Bloomberg reports.

title: Bitcoin looks red again this month, but demand may stir soon: Bitfinex
summary: Bitcoin has broken character for two consecutive months and now faces two possible paths: a resurgence in demand or a deeper accumulation phase.
